svg.aria-label: Animation: geostrophic wind forming and circulating round a low, northern and southern hemispheres
svg.text: Coriolis deflects RIGHT · LOW anticlockwise, HIGH clockwise

g.text: At rest: the PGF pushes the air from the HIGH towards the LOW
Moving air feels Coriolis, which turns it to the RIGHT
Straight isobars: PGF = Coriolis → geostrophic wind, LOW on its LEFT
Curved isobars: PGF > Coriolis → turns anticlockwise round the LOW (gradient wind)

svg.text: Back to the wind: LOW on your LEFT
Coriolis deflects LEFT · LOW clockwise, HIGH anticlockwise

g.text: At rest: the PGF pushes the air from the HIGH towards the LOW
Moving air feels Coriolis, which turns it to the LEFT
Straight isobars: PGF = Coriolis → geostrophic wind, LOW on its RIGHT
Curved isobars: PGF > Coriolis → turns clockwise round the LOW (gradient wind)

svg.text: Back to the wind: LOW on your RIGHT
